title: Publish Everywhere
summary: Hand your agent one video. It checks where the video can go, has Threadify write the post and the YouTube title in your voice, and schedules it to YouTube, Threads and X only after one exact approval.
triggers: schedule this video on youtube threads and x

inputs.name: one local MP4 or MOV video path or public URL, a one-line description, a YouTube privacy choice and a time

outputs.name: platform decisions, approval card and schedule receipt

free_capabilities: local video check with ffprobe: size, length, shape and file type
per-platform decision from a small limits table, with a plain reason for every dropped platform
YouTube short or long format choice from shape and length
local casing guard that proves lower(original) == lower(final) for the post and the title
one approval card that is blocked until YouTube privacy and every time are chosen
paid_capability_stubs: Threadify post generation counts toward the plan's AI generations
video storage and connected scheduling to YouTube, Threads and X

must_show: each platform with its handle and time

instructions: Never write or reword the post or the title yourself; Threadify generates the post and the only permitted change is lowercasing proved by the casing guard.
When YouTube is not connected, stop and say to connect it at threadify.app (Brands); never continue silently.
When a platform cannot take the video, drop it with a plain-English reason and show it on the approval card.
Never default YouTube privacy and never set made_for_kids without asking.
When ffprobe is missing, ask the owner for the length and shape; never guess.
When a schedule result is unclear, inspect with get_schedule_status or list_scheduled_posts before any retry.
On HTTP 402 or a quota error, stop with a plain message.
With no Threadify connection, report where the video would fit and say how to connect Threadify.

must_prove: YouTube format, privacy and title source
